create.name: Sai Maa
create.bio:
Sai Maa, known to students as Her Holiness Jagadguru Sathya Sai Maa, is a spiritual teacher whose work centres on the Divine Feminine, love and conscious living. Her organisation describes her as the first woman to be named Jagadguru in the Vishnuswami lineage, a line it traces back some 2,700 years, and she founded MAA, the community and organisation that carries her teaching, along with humanitarian projects in India focused on schooling and support for women.

She teaches through energetic transmission, meditation and Vedic fire ceremonies called yagyas, and through talks recorded over many years. Students can begin with The MAA Path, a guided online programme led by her long-time disciple Triveni Das, follow forty-day series of daily audio teachings, learn her simple meditation method in short lessons, or join a three-level membership. She also leads live online gatherings, in-person intensives and sacred journeys to Egypt, and her programmes have been held in the United States, Canada, Europe, Japan and India. Her books include Petals of Grace and Conscious Living, collections of her teachings on topics such as forgiveness, relationships and purpose.

courses.title: The Awakened Human
courses.description: A three-day live online gathering with Sai Maa on consciousness, the Divine Feminine and the part each person plays in what comes next for humanity. Reduced rates are listed for members, young adults and newcomers.

courses.title: The MAA Path: Foundations
courses.description: The first stage of the MAA Path: eight live online modules with Triveni Das, a disciple of Sai Maa, plus daily teachings and an introduction to MAA meditation. It is designed to build a steady daily practice alongside work and family life.

courses.title: MAA Membership
courses.description: An ongoing membership in three levels for students who want regular practice, transmissions and community with Sai Maa. Each level adds more teaching and service.

courses.title: 40 Days with Sai Maa
courses.description: Forty days of short audio teachings from Sai Maa, each with a suggested meditation and questions to reflect on. Topics include the Self, the qualities of Spirit and care of the soul.

courses.title: 40 Days of Light
courses.description: A forty-day online series of daily audio broadcasts and practices from Sai Maa about living with more awareness and light. Each day pairs a teaching with contemplation.

courses.title: Your Path to Happiness, Level 1
courses.description: Seven online lessons of about twenty-five minutes teaching the meditation method developed by Sai Maa. Once learned, the practice asks only a few minutes a day.

courses.title: Your Divine Impulse
courses.description: Fourteen recorded discourses by Sai Maa, first broadcast in 2012 and 2013, on moving from separation towards oneness. Listeners are invited to return to them several times.

courses.title: Creation Matrix
courses.description: A seventy-five-lesson online programme that gathers years of Sai Maa's teaching on living as an awakened being. Access lasts for one year.

free_resources.title: Awaken to Your Profound Life
free_resources.description: A free six-part webinar series led by MAA's lead teachers, mixing short teachings with recorded talks by Sai Maa. Each session takes under an hour.

sprint.held: Lead, 6 Nov 2026: held for the owner. Former followers have made widely reported allegations of cult-like control and financial pressure in her organisation (Humanity in Unity); nothing of that is on her own pages. Same line as Adam Apollo (skipped over public accusations, 4 Nov).
